verdict.rationale: Apple's own materials claim second-generation dynamic caching, a next-generation GPU and third-generation ray tracing bring smoother gameplay in titles like Cyberpunk 2077, and the spec sheet confirms a 10-core GPU with hardware ray tracing. The only independent numbers are leaked Geekbench CPU scores, which also show the larger L2 cache; one community post just repeats the vendor's '30% higher graphics' figure. missing for 10: independent game benchmarks or FPS figures in real titles, boost/clock behavior under gaming load, and hands-on corroboration of the GPU gaming claims.

support.subject: As a gamer, this chip drives high frame rates in real games — vendor gaming claims (cache, boost behavior, integrated GPU class) corroborated by independent game benchmarks

citations.quote: The next-generation GPU, enhanced shader cores, second-generation dynamic caching, and third-generation ray-tracing engine on M5 bring more realistic visuals, faster rendering times, and smoother gameplay in titles like Cyberpunk 2077.
Same max clock speed, ~10% pure IPC improvement with 6MB L2 cache (2MB more than M4).
